name: math-warriors
description: An educational math RPG for kids K-5, built with Phaser 3. 15 heroes, 9 floors, turn-based battles powered by math mastery.
author: DD-Builder

scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e

scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
